content.value_statement: Writing Agent Skills requires clear structure and valid metadata. This skill guides authors through folders, frontmatter, references, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md frontmatter fields for a new skill.
Shows the standard folder layout for scripts, references, and assets.
Provides a short process for creating a skill directory and metadata.
Links to a full Agent Skills format specification.
Links to design guidance for progressive disclosure and skill structure.
limitations: Does not include automation scripts for generating files.
Does not validate a completed skill with a bundled checker.
Does not provide domain-specific examples beyond general skill authoring.
Does not manage publishing, packaging, or marketplace submission.

use_cases.title: Draft a first skill
use_cases.description: Create the initial folder, SKILL.md metadata, and concise body instructions for a new Agent Skill.

use_cases.title: Standardize team skill docs
use_cases.description: Use one structure for naming, references, scripts, and validation across team-authored skills.

use_cases.title: Review skill structure
use_cases.description: Check whether a proposed skill uses valid frontmatter and a clear resource layout.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill named <skill-name>. Include valid SKILL.md frontmatter and a short instruction body.

prompt_templates.title: Plan skill resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the folder structure for a skill that needs scripts and reference documents. Explain what belongs in each folder.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SKILL.md for metadata quality, concise instructions, and appropriate references. Suggest precise improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a production-ready skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a complete Agent Skill for <workflow>. Define activation wording, resource files, validation checks, and edge cases.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing pull requests.
output_examples.output: A skill plan with a lowercase name, a clear description, a short SKILL.md outline, and suggested reference files.

output_examples.input: Check whether my skill folder is organized correctly.
output: Confirms whether SKILL.md is present and named correctly.
Identifies optional folders that have a clear purpose.
Flags overly deep references or missing metadata.

output_examples.input: Turn my long skill instructions into a cleaner structure.
output_examples.output: A concise main instruction flow with detailed material moved into focused reference documents.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into focused reference files.
Write descriptions that state both what the skill does and when to use it.
Use only optional folders that contain real scripts, references, or assets.
anti_patterns: Do not create empty scripts, references, or assets folders.
Do not use vague descriptions that hide the skill trigger conditions.
Do not bury core instructions behind many nested reference files.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create Agent Skills that use SKILL.md metadata, clear instructions, and optional supporting resources.

faq.question: Does it generate files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides authoring guidance and process steps, but it does not include a generation script.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and Claude workflows that support Agent Skills.

faq.question: What should the description include?
faq.answer: The description should explain what the skill does and when an agent should activate it.

faq.question: When should I add references?
faq.answer: Add references when detailed material would make SKILL.md too long or hard to scan.

faq.question: Does the skill cover marketplace publishing?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on authoring structure and validation, not marketplace packaging or submission.
